title: Implement configurable status semantic categories
description: Add semantic_category to StatusDefinition and resolve business logic by category instead of hard-coded in_progress key.

comments.author: ubuntu
comments.text: Merged PR #228 into develop (merge SHA fd7b22fa). Delivers semantic_category on StatusDefinition (todo|in_progress|done); --claim, Jira/Beads import, right-now, and display paths resolve status keys via status_semantics helpers.
